# Suspend scheduled demo fuzzing for all teams except typeberry and turbojam

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary
- Drops the `schedule:` / `cron` trigger from all `*-demo-tiny.yml` and `*-demo-full.yml` workflows (46 files, 92 lines).
- Keeps typeberry and turbojam on the daily cron — they back the dashboard's reference runs.
- `workflow_dispatch` and the `pull_request` path filters are left intact, so any team can still trigger a one-off demo run manually or via a PR that touches the workflow.
- Performance workflows are out of scope and unchanged.

## Why
The official W3F self-fuzzing app is now available at https://fuzz.jamtoaster.network/, which makes the per-team daily demo runs in this repo redundant for everyone except the reference targets.

## Test plan
- [ ] Confirm the GitHub Actions list no longer shows scheduled runs for the suspended teams after the next 18:00 UTC tick.
- [ ] Sanity-check one disabled workflow (e.g. `boka-demo-tiny`) can still be manually dispatched from the Actions tab.
- [ ] Confirm `typeberry-demo-*` and `turbojam-demo-*` still fire on schedule.
